question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Sid is / bring the cake / for Ria’s birthday.
solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 1'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Sid is / bring the cake / for Ria’s birthday." contains a grammatical error.
 
• The error lies in the part "bring the cake". 
 
• It should be corrected with "is bringing" to form the appropriate present continuous tense.
 
• We will not change the helping verb. The only change we can make in this sentence in main verb.
 
• 'Bring' will be changed into 'bringing' and all other part will remain same.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: ' Sid is bringing the cake for Ria's birthday'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "for Ria’s birthday" This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
 
• Option 3: "No error" The sentence does contain an error hence this option isn't correct.
 
• Option 4: "Sid is" This part of the sentence is correct and does not contain any errors.
